statements.status_notes: GHSA-h749-fxx7-pwpg (CVE-2026-39414) describes unbounded memory allocation in the S3 Select CSV reader's nextSplit(). Open-source minio has no patched release (first_patched_version is null). This image ships the TuxCare ELS rebuild of RELEASE.2025-10-15T17-29-55Z. TuxCare lists this CVE as Won't Fix for that release (https://tuxcare.com/cve-tracker/cve/details/cve-2026-39414/). nextSplit is still present in the ELS binary, and S3 Select is reachable by an authenticated client. No TuxCare advisory was found that names this CVE as fixed.
